title: Styio Project Roadmap
purpose: Provide the single review entry for project stages, boundaries, dependencies, and maintainer decisions.
goal: Agree on one reasonable delivery structure before activating new implementation groups.
description: Owns the reviewable roadmap; child Plans own foundation, compiler, optimization, and release scope.

title: Compiler Correctness
purpose: Close current compiler debt before allowing performance work to redefine behavior.
goal: Finish the P0 placeholder inventory and select one fail-closed compiler closure.
description: Owns placeholder classification, parser authority, IR verification, and selection of the first bounded implementation cluster.

title: IR Loop-Control Legality
purpose: Deliver the maintainer-approved first post-P0 compiler-correctness closure.
goal: Make the independent StyioIR verifier reject break and continue outside an enclosing loop while preserving valid loop control.
description: Owns one verifier-only structural legality closure and its focused tests; parser, Sema, codegen semantics, multi-level break, and adjacent compiler debt remain out of scope.

title: Algorithmic Optimization
purpose: Sequence algorithm work by real module dependencies and measurable value.
goal: Advance parser, IR, type, resource, and stream algorithms through bounded evidence-backed checkpoints.
description: A and B are established facts; C, D, and E are independent post-P0 candidates, while F precedes G.

title: Parser Core Unification
purpose: Deliver the maintainer-selected OPT-C parser optimization as one bounded, evidence-backed task group.
goal: Unify accepted expression parsing around one explicit precedence and associativity authority without fallback or diagnostic drift.
description: Owns parser precedence authority, bounded stack behavior, equivalence and performance acceptance, and owner-document synchronization; new syntax and adjacent optimization stages remain out of scope.

title: Verified IR Dead-Suffix Elimination
purpose: Deliver the authorized OPT-D checkpoint as one measured and verifier-guarded IR pass family.
goal: Eliminate provably unreachable statement suffixes through the verified StyioIR pass manager without changing live behavior.
description: Owns one control-flow-local dead-statement family, semantic-equivalence evidence, pass statistics, focused performance evidence, and owner documentation; general def-use DCE and unrelated optimizer work remain out of scope.

title: Bounded Callable Constraint Worklist
purpose: Deliver the authorized OPT-E checkpoint as one terminating type-constraint solving closure.
goal: Consolidate callable constraint reduction into a deterministic bounded worklist while preserving handle and representation facts.
description: Owns one existing callable-constraint family, termination and recomputation bounds, deterministic diagnostics, allocation evidence, and owner documentation; new constraint vocabulary and resource typestate remain out of scope.

title: Resource Typestate Dataflow
purpose: Deliver the authorized OPT-F checkpoint as one canonical resource typestate/dataflow closure.
goal: Consolidate one active resource family's state transitions into a deterministic bounded analysis that OPT-G can consume.
description: Owns one selected resource scenario, state lattice, transfer and join rules, convergence and memory evidence, diagnostics, and complete state-owner migration; unrelated resource families and stream scheduling remain out of scope.

title: Ecosystem Release
purpose: Record the maintainer-selected Styio-only release boundary after ownership is frozen.
goal: Freeze Styio-only functional acceptance and waive cross-repository ecosystem matrix work for this candidate.
description: Ownership remains documented; release scope is Styio-only with one repo-local full functional regression as the sole acceptance gate; Pafio, Platform, and Vityo matrix participation is excluded.

entry_gate.title: Maintainer selected Styio-only release scope
conditions: Participating repository is styio-nightly only; cross-repository ecosystem matrix is waived.

title: Deterministic Zip Barrier Facts
purpose: Deliver the authorized OPT-G checkpoint as one canonical deterministic stream-concurrency closure.
goal: Make one active finite zip-barrier scenario preserve explicit frame and synchronization facts through IR and code generation.
description: Owns one existing finite zip path and its frame identity, barrier membership, synchronization mode, commit boundary, verifier invariants, and bounded evidence; snapshot joins, new queues, multi-writer merge, and new syntax remain out of scope.

title: Bounded Task Scheduling Pressure
purpose: Close the remaining OPT-G bounded scheduling checkpoint on one active structured task scenario.
goal: Give active task launch and await a bounded, wakeable, cancelable scheduler path with observable non-failure pressure.
description: Owns the existing task ready queue, producer/consumer wake-up, cancellation/close settlement, pressure counters, parser-through-runtime task evidence, race/sanitizer evidence, and bounded-memory proof; new syntax and general stream resource policies remain out of scope.

title: String Input and List Handle Correctness
purpose: Close the runtime-value defects exposed while implementing a real Styio Brainfuck compiler example.
goal: Provide natural string-to-character input and correct mutable list ownership across function boundaries, then consume both in the canonical example.
description: Owns one cohesive parser-through-runtime value-interface closure: line string ingestion and character materialization, mutable list parameter/return lifetime, focused regressions, and the downstream Brainfuck example migration; unrelated CLI argument design and other container families remain out of scope.

title: Structured Function Results
purpose: Replace ad-hoc integer protocols with one general structured value boundary discovered through the Brainfuck compiler example.
goal: Make heterogeneous tuple values, including nested collection handles, safe function return values and consume them in the canonical Brainfuck compiler.
description: Owns one parser-through-codegen tuple-value closure, projection/destructuring surface, nested handle ownership, focused regressions, and complete downstream migration away from the status-prefixed bytecode list; named records, mutable tuple fields, variadic tuples, and unrelated aggregate families remain out of scope.

title: Minimum Break Spelling
purpose: Restore the intended visible distinction between an accidental single caret and an authored loop break.
goal: Require every break statement to use a contiguous run of at least two carets while keeping any longer run equivalent to nearest-loop break.
description: Owns one compiler syntax closure across both parser routes, deterministic single-caret diagnostics, authoritative language documentation, existing source migration, and the canonical Brainfuck example; XOR and break depth semantics remain unchanged.
